flowNotes: PRVDAY01 is three programs in sequence on one master; the modern system is event-driven: an accepted application (ApplicationValidated) registers a PENDING provider, which is screened (ProviderRegistered -> INITIAL screening) and tiered (ScreeningCompleted -> RiskTierAssigned) within seconds, before the screening run is started. The export 'after-step010' is therefore taken after those events settled, not between PRVENR01 and PRVSCR01.

The screening run (PRVSCR01) screens only providers with flag U that have no INITIAL screening yet: here the two seed providers 1005925213 and 1005933068; the new providers were screened by the event before the run, so SCRNOUT holds their rows only if a screening of the run exists.
D-019: nothing becomes ACTIVE without an analyst approval. The legacy run did not make any new provider ACTIVE (they stay P flag U/P), so no approval was given by hand.
D-003: the modern system does not reset the due date of every provider on each run; the due date is set at approval.

STATE WHEN EACH FILE WAS WRITTEN, modern: APPERROR = written by the intake run itself, before any provider of the file was registered. after-step010 = after the intake run and after the events registered the validated applications as PENDING, screened them and tiered the passed ones. SCRNOUT = written by the screening run, which screened only the two seed providers with flag U (1005925213, 1005933068); the screenings of the new providers happened earlier, by events (logs/screenings-of-new-providers.json). after-step040 = after the screening run and the events it caused (screen flag, risk tier).

STATE WHEN EACH FILE WAS WRITTEN, legacy (golden manifests): APPERROR = STEP010 (the load stopped at the first bad application; only the baseline run). SCRNOUT = STEP030, which screened every provider with flag U in one pass (the 3 new and the 2 seed providers: 20 rows). after-step010 = master right after PRVENR01; after-step040 = master after PRVRSK01 (tier and due date rewritten for every record). The baseline legacy run stopped after STEP010 (RC 4), so it has no SCRNOUT and no tier; the modern baseline run went on through screening and tiering.

Modern screening verdicts come from the mocked sources (D-005): each licence is looked up in the licence-board mock (WireMock, infra/wiremock/mappings/license-board); the legacy stubs returned P for everyone. The verdict of every new provider is in logs/screenings-of-new-providers.json.
SEED PREMISE (checked at run time): the exported BEFORE master equals the legacy provider-master-seed-sorted.dat byte for byte (16 of 16 records)
normalised: record separator only: the API returns one record per line (LF); the .ascii file holds the same records back to back like the converted golden files; no field is changed
